title: Color grading engine: float grade stage and primary corrections
base: main 894c9d32 (CG2 continues after CG0 and CG1 on the same branch)
visualAcceptance: none: software measurements only; no owner review of graded pictures yet

effects.grade.primary: lift (black moves, white stays), gamma (negatives unchanged), gain, offset per channel and master; contrast about pivot; luma-weighted shadows/highlights; saturation; hue rotation about Rec.709 luma; color boost
effects.grade.white-balance: Bradford adaptation in linear light from a Planckian temperature (Kang 2002, 1667-25000 K) plus a Duv tint (tint/5000, positive greener) to the 6500 K locus white
effects.grade.cdl: ASC CDL slope/offset/power/saturation; clamp 1 = Release 1.2, 0 = unclamped (power skipped below 0)
effects.grade.rgb-mixer: color.matrix's parameters and design formula in float

delivered.stage: consecutive grade.* effects fuse into one stage on straight color: one generated float32 fragment shader on WebGL2, color-science float64 on Canvas; one half-up quantization on exit with the CGA premultiply rule; neutral operators dropped
delivered.deviation: midtone detail (listed under grade.primary in the plan) is spatial, not pointwise; deferred to CG13 (texture operations) so the stage stays fused and pointwise
delivered.references: packages/color-science/src/grade.ts; vectors/temperature.json added to CG0 (Kang 2002 locus, Bradford matrices); other CG0 vector files unchanged

checks.check: Fixture: a value pushed above 1.0 by one operation is recovered by the next (fails on the chroma-node math, passes here)
checks.evidence: gray-ramp-256 through grade.primary gain 2 then gain 0.5: max error 0 on Canvas and WebGL2; the same with color.exposure +1/-1 stop (8-bit) loses up to 127 codes; chroma-node's applyPrimaryCorrection clamps every stage to 0-1 (CG1 audit), so it cannot recover

checks.check: grade.cdl matches the ASC reference values within tolerance
checks.evidence: the stage's CDL is color-science applyCdl, which matches the CG0 ASC v1.2 vectors within 1e-12 (8 cases, CG1 tests); on the renderer the cdl-asc and cdl-unclamped cases match the float64 reference exactly on Canvas and within 1 code on WebGL2 (0 channels at 1)

checks.check: GPU matches the float64 reference within the approved parity bound on all CG0 fixtures; repeated renders are byte-identical
checks.evidence: 9 cases (each operator typical and extreme, a five-operator chain, a neutral run) x 8 CG0 stills = 72 rows: Canvas vs reference 0 on every opaque pixel; WebGL2 vs reference max 1, 32 channels at 1 in total (16 in white-balance-warm-scene, 16 in mixer-owner-like); every repeated WebGL2 render byte-identical; the neutral run is an exact identity on both backends

checks.check: A 16-step gray ramp through ten stacked neutral-sum corrections shows no added banding compared with one pass (measured, not viewed)
checks.evidence: ten grade.primary corrections (gamma 1.5 / gain 0.8 then gain 1.25, five times) plus the inverse gamma: gray-steps-16 keeps 16 levels and gray-ramp-256 keeps 256, max difference 0 on both backends; the CG1 spike measured 57 of 256 levels for the same idea through 8-bit intermediates

checks.check: A graded native-video composition renders and exports through the existing path; effect versions appear in export metadata
checks.evidence: CG0 moving-disc.mp4 with the five-operator chain, comp render on canvas2d and webgl2: 48/48 frames each; the scene manifest's effectVersions lists grade.primary, grade.white-balance, grade.cdl and grade.rgb-mixer at 1.0.0
checks.note: This section was added to the test and committed (a1705a23) before it was first run; the first run passed.

checks.evidence: color.* effects are untouched; the CG0 color-effect baseline, the CGA grade parity test, the CE6 catalogue (frozen files) and the composition baselines are rerun

checks.check: All parameters animatable; works on video, sequence, image, precomp and adjustment layers
checks.evidence: 108 layer-kind/animation/seek cases (solid, image, text, shape, provider, group, precomp, collapsed precomp, adjustment; static and keyed controls; forward, reverse and random seeks), 1,296 frames, backend difference 0; native video exported above; PNG sequences use the same layer effect path (not separately rendered)

ce6.baseline: tests/visual/composition-effect-catalogue/darwin-arm64-float-grade-1.json, written with --write-float-grade-baseline, then checked; the frozen CE6 baseline files are unchanged

failedRunsAndReruns: CG2 browser test before the renderer wiring: failed with comp-effect-unavailable: grade.primary has no Canvas implementation (failing first).

CG2 browser test run 1: the banding stack's undo gamma 1/1.6^5 = 0.095 was below the contract minimum 0.1 and validation rejected it; the fixture now uses 1.5 (1/1.5^5 = 0.13), the bound is unchanged.
